digest.component_or_area: code-review and plan-review gates: per-pass model routing and class declaration
propositions: One environment variable (REBAR_LLM_MODEL) cannot express per-pass model routing needed across four passes (Pass-1 finder, Pass-2 verifier, Pass-3 decide, Pass-4 coach) on non-default providers.
Code-review gate's base, round_a, round_b, and coach steps currently inherit cfg.model implicitly and do not declare per-step model classes, preventing provider-aware resolution.
Verifier downgrade logic in verify.py:269 and completion.py:332 inverts on non-default providers, causing Pass-2/Pass-4 to follow Pass-1 onto the wrong model instead of downgrading to sonnet-family.

Batch runner steps cannot use step-level model: declarations because interpreter.py:384-395 reads only from batch: sub-dict and ignores enclosing step model:, making single-rung model_ladder the required syntax.
Per-pass model declarations in code-review.yaml are not honored at runtime; the plumbing between YAML declaration and resolver execution is broken (tracked in b690).
